summary: Verified the iteration-5 change: the free-trial modal now uses three direct product cards (no dropdown/continue). Tested all 6 modal entry points across index/solutions/pricing/contact plus the product-modal chained trigger; verified card hrefs and real navigation to the three external URLs; verified responsive layout at 375px and 768px; verified close button. No page/console errors on any tested page (the only console errors observed were 'Failed to fetch' from include.js aborted during expect_navigation — expected side-effect, not a bug).

responsive.375px: 3 cards stack vertically, no overflow, all visible/clickable
responsive.768px: 3 cards visible in row, no overflow, close works

verifications.console_errors: None on any trial-modal flow (Failed-to-fetch entries come from include.js fetches aborted by expect_navigation and are expected)

regression_spot_check.nav_carets_and_active_underline: visible in 1440px screenshot (Our Signulu Solutions + Industries carets, Pricing active underline)
regression_spot_check.note: Deeper pricing plan-price / estimator / contact prefill / industry ticks were fully validated in iterations 1-4 and were untouched by this change; the iteration-5 diff only edited trial-modal.html, theme.css and include.js.

critical_code_review_comments: include.js does not gracefully handle Failed-to-fetch errors during page unload; consider aborting via AbortController or ignoring aborted-fetch errors so the console stays clean during rapid navigation (cosmetic).

Each page duplicates
and product-modal include — fine for a static site, but if you ever add a second trial entry-point that stacks modals you should ensure Bootstrap instance is properly disposed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 free-trial card flow is green. If future work re-touches include.js modal handling, re-run the 6 entry-point smoke and the 3-card navigation check. Base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
